environment.description: Service deployed behind an internal NLB (Network Load Balancer) in AWS VPC subnet 10.200.0.0/16. The NLB target group has a security group (sg-0a4f8e2c1b) with inbound rules permitting TCP/8080 only from three source prefixes: 10.50.0.0/16 (corporate VPN egress), 10.100.0.0/16 (CI/CD runners), and 172.20.0.0/14 (partner API gateway). The NLB is configured as 'internal' scheme (not internet-facing). Additionally, the VPC has no Internet Gateway attached and no NAT gateway route for the subnet hosting the NLB. VPC Flow Logs are enabled with REJECT logging. The EKS node security group only allows ingress from the NLB security group on port 8080.
